Doppler examination demonstrated a solid vascular mass that displaced the internal and external carotid arteries without direct invasion. No suspicious lymphadenopathy or other abnormal findings were detected (Figure 1).

in_text_mentions: Histopathological examination of the excised tumor revealed the prevailing histologic pattern of epithelioid cells arranged in distinct clusters separated by a prominent capillary network. These findings were consistent with the diagnosis of a carotid body tumor (Figure 3). The patient underwent regular follow-up appointments to monitor for any signs of recurrence and assess postoperative recovery.
